body.p: Claims 1, 4-7, and 10-24 are pending, with claims 1 and 19-20 being independent.
Claims 1, 4-6, 10-11, and 19-20 are amended. Claims 2-3 and 8-9 are canceled. Claims 21-24 are new. No new matter is added.
Claim Objections

In the Office Action, claim 3 is objected to because of an informality. Although the objection is rendered moot by the cancelation of claim 3, the features of claim 3 incorporated into claims 1, 19 and 20 have been amended to recite "areas cover" for clarity. Removal of the claim objection is therefore respectfully requested.
In the Office Action, claim 6 rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112 due to an alleged lack of

clarity. Claim 6 is amended to replace "closed in a circumferential direction" by "a closed area," for clarity purposes, support for which can be found at least in original Fig. 7. Reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejection of claim 6 in its current forms are hereby requested.
In the Office Action, claims 1-2 and 20 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 102 as being anticipated by U.S. Pub. No. 2018/0368701 ("Vule").

In the interest of expediting prosecution, independent claims 1 and 20 each are amended to include the features of allowable claim 9 and intervening claims 2-3 and 8, and independent claim 19 is amended to include the allowable features of allowable claim 10 and intervening claims 2-3 and 8. The amendments do not indicate an agreement with the rejections presented in the Office Action.
In view of the above, the independent claims and their respective dependents are in condition for allowance. Removal of the rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 102 is respectfully requested.

In the Office Action, claims 3-6 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Vule in view of Tanaka (WO 2016031221); claims 7-8 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Vule in view of Tanaka and Harrison-Noonan (EP 3459447); claims 11-12 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Vule in view of Jumbe (US 20210345939); claim 13 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Vule in view of Jumbe and Kline (US 20200015748); claim 14 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Vule in view of Jumbe and Greenly (US 20180027908); claim 15 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Vule in view of Jumbe, Greenly and Townsend (US 20160324470); claim 16 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Vule in view of Jumbe, Greenly and Mehra (US 20210278561); claim 17 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Vule; claim 18 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Vule in view of Martin (US 20220128950); and claim 19 is rejected under 35 U.s.C. @ 103 as being unpatentable over Vule in view of Fish (US 20190133464).

In the interest of expediting prosecution, the independent claims are amended to incorporate allowable subject matter. Specifically, claim 1 is amended to incorporate the subject matter of originally filed claims 2-3 and 8-9, and corresponding amendments are made to independent claims 19 and 20. The amendments do not indicate an agreement with the rejections presented in the Office Action.
In view of the above, removal of the rejections under 35 U.S.C. @ 103 is respectfully requested.
New claim 21-24

New claims 21 and 22 are believed to be patentable at least because of their ultimate dependency from independent claim 19. Support for new claim 21 can be found at least at originally filed claim 7, and paragraphs [0006], [0021] and [0025] of the specification. Support for new claim 22 can be found at least at originally filed claim 9, and paragraphs [0006], [0021] and [0025] of the specification.
New claims 23 and 24 are believed to be patentable at least because of their ultimate dependency from independent claim 20. Support for new claim 23 can be found at least at

originally filed claim 10, and paragraphs [0007], [0021] and [0025] of the specification. Support for new claim 24 can be found at least at originally filed claims 11-12 and 20, and paragraphs [0007], [0021] and [0025] of the specification.
The indication of allowable matter in claims 9-10 is gratefully acknowledged.

It is respectfully submitted that a full and complete response to the Office Action has been made. Favorable reconsideration of the application is kindly sought. If the Examiner has any further questions or concerns, the Examiner is invited to contact the Applicant's undersigned attorney.
Respectfully submitted, HODGSON RUSS LLP
